extras: This is a community-maintained rebuild of an original plugin, implemented using AI because the original repository was incomplete.
motivation: The original repository was missing main.js, prompting this implementation to be rebuilt using AI.
problem: Users need a simple way to track changes, revert to previous states, and compare different iterations of their notes.
summary: Version View is a version control plugin that allows users to save, manage, compare, and restore file versions within Obsidian.
